reviewed_by: Codex focused review for restart-recovery backpressure
reason: The change limits only automatically recovered provider turns so a Core restart cannot schedule an unbounded backlog of large routing histories on the API event loop. Four focused recovery cases cover safe goal recovery, multiple interrupted causes, the new concurrency bound and slot handoff, and automatic retry after a transient recovery failure.
exclusions: Full suites are not approved and are excluded. Normal operator-started provider turns, harness execution, queue ordering, HTTP response contracts, storage schema, frontend rendering, native packaging, and browser interaction code are unchanged. Frontend, native, and Playwright selections are empty because this is a Core-internal recovery scheduler change; the production real-Core and LAN response path will be measured separately after deployment.
